name: doubao-media
description: Doubao (豆包) image and video generation fallback: status, plan/quota detection, official watermark opt-out, and media generation through one local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Use Doubao (豆包) when the primary image model (image 2 / 2.5) is unavailable or its quota is nearly exhausted. Reports the account's subscription plan and remaining image/video quota, reads and changes the official AI-generation watermark opt-out, then generates images and videos and saves them locally. Scope is deliberately limited to image and video generation.
